scenario.title: The Picnic Proposal
scenario.context: A sunny afternoon in a bustling city park
scenario.description: Two friends, Alex and Jamie, are enjoying a picnic in the park. Alex has a business idea and wants to partner with Jamie. Jamie must decide based on the reality of the situation.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Enthusiastic, optimistic and persuasive, eager to start a new business venture
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Rational, calm, understanding, and keen to consider all the facts before making a decision
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Easily swayed, impulsive, and overexcited by the prospect of starting a new venture without considering the reality of the situation
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Dismissive, pessimistic, and quick to shoot down the idea without considering all the information
scenario.speaker2_persona_high: High EQ - Rational, calm, understanding, and keen to consider all the facts before making a decision

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Hey, Jamie, I've been mulling over this business idea I have.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: Oh, really? Let's hear it, Alex.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I want to start a food truck business. We can use unique, locally sourced ingredients and offer something truly different.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: That sounds interesting, but we need to consider the realities. Do we have enough capital? What about the competition?

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: I have some savings and I thought we could start small. As for the competition, I believe our unique concept will make us stand out.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: I appreciate your optimism, Alex, but we need to do a thorough market research before we jump in. Let's take this step by step.
